title: The Missing Charter
description: Mayor Bramble's village charter is completely blank. Without it, nobody knows the rules.

healMoment.visual: Town hall windows glow warm gold. Color ripples outward across the square.
healMoment.audio: A deep hum resolves into a warm chord. Three-note ascending chime plays.

npcReaction.speaker: Bramble
npcReaction.text: I can read it again! Every word, clear as day.

npcReaction.speaker: Bramble
npcReaction.text: Welcome to Bughollow! That's our name!

healMoment.worldChange: Town hall restored. Village signpost readable.
